test_anchor_3d_range_generator: test the Anchor3DRangeGenerator by building it with ranges, sizes, and rotations config then generating single level grid anchors
test_aligned_anchor_generator: test the AlignedAnchor3DRangeGenerator by building it with scales, sizes, and rotations then generating multi level grid anchors
test_aligned_anchor_generator_per_cls: test the AlignedAnchor3DRangeGeneratorPerCls by building per class anchors with ranges and sizes then generating grid anchors
build_anchor_generator: build an anchor generator from a config dict using mmdet3d core anchor build_anchor_generator function
run_3d_anchor_tests: run pytest on the 3D anchor generator test file to validate Anchor3DRangeGenerator and AlignedAnchor3DRangeGenerator
